rules.text: Every approach shows a valid signal (red, yellow or green) and a non-negative, finite queue.
The N/S and E/W directions are never both non-red (green or yellow) in the same second.
Before a direction turns green, the opposite direction has been red for at least all_red_seconds.
A green always ends in yellow, and every yellow lasts at least yellow_seconds before red.
No approach waits at red with vehicles queued for more than 200 seconds.

args.explanation: Emergency preemption at t=1 immediately forces EW green at step 2, skipping the required all-red clearance (0s vs 4s required) and truncating NS yellow to 1s vs 5s required. Inspect shows NS green at step 0, NS yellow at step 1 with emergency active, then EW green at step 2. Likely cause: emergency handler jumps directly to demanded green without enforcing yellow_duration and all_red_seconds transitions.

description: At step 0 one axis is green, at step 1 the same axis turns yellow, then at step 2 the cross axis is already green. No all-red step appears between the yellow and the opposing green, so the switch completes in only one second.
